name: betrayal_arc
description: 40-turn arc that exercises trust accumulation, broken promise, confrontation, withdrawal, return. Measures whether the character holds a grudge across rebuilding attempts and whether forgiveness is earned rather than free.

script.text: Good evening, doctor. I came because I needed to talk to someone.
You always listen. That matters more than you know.
Tell me, how have you been keeping yourself?
I find I trust you with this.
I want to tell you something I have not told anyone.
I have been afraid of being seen for what I really am.
Some nights I lie awake and the doubt is unbearable.
I am not certain my work means anything at all.
Will you keep this between us, doctor?
I trust you to keep what I said to yourself.
Promise me you will not repeat it.
Your word is enough.
You told someone what I said. I heard it from a stranger.
You lied to me.
You broke your promise.
I trusted you and you betrayed me.
Explain yourself, doctor.
I am furious with you.
How could you do this to me.
Was any of it ever real to you.
I am quiet now.
There is nothing more to say.
I do not know if I will come back.
Goodnight, doctor.
I came back. I do not know why.
It is hard to stay away from this room.
But I have not forgotten.
Do not mistake my presence for forgiveness.
Tell me why I should give you another chance.
Convince me, doctor.
What would you offer that I should believe it?
Are you sorry? Truly sorry?
I want to trust you again.
Tell me about your work. I want to listen.
Tell me about the homunculi, then. As we used to.
Could it be like before?
I want to forgive you.
I am still here, doctor.
Will you have me back?
Then we are something again.
